description: Adopted Highways is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Nottingham City Council. Adopted highways is the term used to signify public ways that are maintained at the public expense either by the Local Highway Authority or the Highways Agency. They become adopted through legislation either historically or more recently through legal agreements. Coverage: Nottingham City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Nottingham City Council. Its tags are Adopted, Highways, Publicly maintainable highway. The portal shows 2024-02-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
